neighbours.label: the single-dash short option token ' -' / '-' of a command-line flag (ls -la, sed -i, '-v'), as opposed to long '--' options (the + pole)
fire:
To see hidden files, open a terminal and run:

    ls -la /var/log
result = subprocess.run(['grep', '-r', 'TODO', 'src/'], capture_output=True)
Unpack the release first:

    tar -xzf release.tar.gz -C /opt/app
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--verbose', '-v', action='store_true')
Save your work with a short message:

    git commit -m 'fix typo in readme'
Connect to the staging box on its custom port:

    ssh -p 2222 deploy@staging
if os.system("sed -i 's/debug=1/debug=0/' app.conf") != 0:
    raise RuntimeError('sed failed')
Back up the database before upgrading:

    pg_dump -h localhost -U admin shop > shop.sql
quiet:
To see hidden files, open a terminal and run:

    ls --all /var/log
result = subprocess.run(['grep', '--recursive', 'TODO', 'src/'], capture_output=True)
Unpack the release first:

    tar --extract --file release.tar.gz
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--verbose', action='store_true')
Save your work with a short message:

    git commit --message 'fix typo in readme'
Connect to the staging box as the deploy user:

    ssh deploy@staging
if os.system("sed --in-place 's/debug=1/debug=0/' app.conf") != 0:
    raise RuntimeError('sed failed')
Back up the database before upgrading:

    pg_dump --host localhost --username admin shop > shop.sql

notes: the - and + poles split short '-x' flags from long '--xxx' options; near misses use the long forms
